mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_call_log ( request_id, user_id, api_key_id, model_alias, channel, stream, prompt_tokens, cached_input_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, status, error_code, duration_ms, created_at, price_version, input_units_per_million, cached_input_units_per_million, output_units_per_million, cost_units, cost_calculation_status, reserved_units, billing_status, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{userId}, #{apiKeyId}, #{modelAlias}, #{channel}, #{stream}, #{promptTokens}, #{cachedInputTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{status}, #{errorCode}, #{durationMs}, #{createdAt}, #{priceVersion}, #{inputUnitsPerMillion}, #{cachedInputUnitsPerMillion}, #{outputUnitsPerMillion}, #{costUnits}, #{costCalculationStatus}, #{reservedUnits}, #{billingStatus}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id AS requestId, user_id AS userId, api_key_id AS apiKeyId, model_alias AS modelAlias, channel, stream, prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, cached_input_tokens AS cachedInputTokens, completion_tokens AS completionTokens, total_tokens AS totalTokens, status, error_code AS errorCode, duration_ms AS durationMs, created_at AS createdAt, price_version AS priceVersion, input_units_per_million AS inputUnitsPerMillion, cached_input_units_per_million AS cachedInputUnitsPerMillion, output_units_per_million AS outputUnitsPerMillion, cost_units AS costUnits, cost_calculation_status AS costCalculationStatus, reserved_units AS reservedUnits, billing_status AS billingStatus, updated_at AS updatedAt, release_reason AS releaseReason FROM chat_call_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) AS successCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failedCount FROM chat_call_log

SELECT id, request_id AS requestId, user_id AS userId, api_key_id AS apiKeyId, model_alias AS modelAlias, channel, stream, prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, cached_input_tokens AS cachedInputTokens, completion_tokens AS completionTokens, total_tokens AS totalTokens, status, error_code AS errorCode, duration_ms AS durationMs, created_at AS createdAt, price_version AS priceVersion, input_units_per_million AS inputUnitsPerMillion, cached_input_units_per_million AS cachedInputUnitsPerMillion, output_units_per_million AS outputUnitsPerMillion, cost_units AS costUnits, cost_calculation_status AS costCalculationStatus, reserved_units AS reservedUnits, billing_status AS billingStatus, updated_at AS updatedAt, release_reason AS releaseReason FROM chat_call_log WHERE request_id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_call_log SET prompt_tokens = #{promptTokens}, cached_input_tokens = #{cachedInputTokens}, completion_tokens = #{completionTokens}, total_tokens = #{totalTokens}, status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, cost_units = #{costUnits}, cost_calculation_status = #{costCalculationStatus}, billing_status = #{billingStatus}, release_reason = #{releaseReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND billing_status IN ('RESERVED', 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id AS requestId, user_id AS userId, api_key_id AS apiKeyId, model_alias AS modelAlias, channel, stream, prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, cached_input_tokens AS cachedInputTokens, completion_tokens AS completionTokens, total_tokens AS totalTokens, status, error_code AS errorCode, duration_ms AS durationMs, created_at AS createdAt, price_version AS priceVersion, input_units_per_million AS inputUnitsPerMillion, cached_input_units_per_million AS cachedInputUnitsPerMillion, output_units_per_million AS outputUnitsPerMillion, cost_units AS costUnits, cost_calculation_status AS costCalculationStatus, reserved_units AS reservedUnits, billing_status AS billingStatus, updated_at AS updatedAt, release_reason AS releaseReason FROM chat_call_log WHERE id > #{afterId} AND billing_status IN ('RESERVED', 'PENDING') ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 50

WITH samples AS ( SELECT api_key_id, channel, model_alias, prompt_tokens, cached_input_tokens, cost_units, CASE WHEN prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL AND cached_input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND prompt_tokens >= 0 AND cached_input_tokens >= 0 AND cached_input_tokens <= prompt_tokens THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cache_sample, CASE WHEN billing_status = 'SETTLED' AND cost_units IS NOT NULL AND cost_units >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS settled_sample FROM chat_call_log WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND api_key_id IS NOT NULL AND channel IS NOT NULL AND model_alias IS NOT NULL ) SELECT api_key_id AS apiKeyId, channel, model_alias AS modelAlias, COUNT(*) AS successfulRequests, SUM(cache_sample) AS cacheSampleRequest, SUM( CASE WHEN cache_sample = 1 THEN prompt_tokens ELSE 0 END ) AS sampleInputTokens, SUM( CASE WHEN cache_sample = 1 THEN cached_input_tokens ELSE 0 END ) AS cachedInputTokens, SUM(settled_sample) AS settledRequests, SUM( CASE WHEN settled_sample = 1 THEN cost_units ELSE 0 END ) AS settledCostUnits FROM samples GROUP BY api_key_id, channel, model_alias ORDER BY api_key_id, channel, model_alias
